Common areas are fully furnished! The apartment is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas.
